name: Hazel Hex
lore: Lantern Marsh’s kindly witch ties glowing embers to spinning spell-chains. Her broom delivers remedies—and a few surprises—to friends along the swamp roads.

primary.name: Wickchain
primary.description: A spinning chain fireball hits one foe for 18 damage and 35% slow for 2s. If it misses or hits a wall, it leaves a poison pool for 4s: 2 poison damage per second, 30% slow.
primary.ui_brief: One projectile • 18 damage + slow • poison on a miss

secondary.name: Broom Express
secondary.description: Fly toward the selected point, up to 1100 range along a clear route. Drop up to six warned bombs: 10 damage, 0.45s stun and 2 burn damage per second for 3s. Cannot attack or dodge during flight.
secondary.ui_brief: Long flight • up to six stunning, burning bombs

special.name: Neighbourhood Brew
special.description: Place a cauldron for 7s. It lobs 8-damage poison splatters toward nearby foes every 1.0s, leaving slowing poison pools. Within 150 reach, allies gain +5% damage and 8% life-on-hit, capped at 6 healing per second. Auras do not stack; damage-over-time does not trigger healing. Each volley fires at every visible enemy within 310 reach.
special.ui_brief: Cauldron • attacks all foes in range • allied aura

passive: Ember Infusion: Broom Express bomb burns last one extra second.

technique.name: Cold Wick
technique.description: Trade ground poison for a stronger direct hit and a greater slow.

attack.name: Cold Wick
attack.description: 23 direct damage and 50% slow for 2s. Missed shots leave slowing frost pools without poison.

final_technique.name: Welcoming Brew
final_technique.description: Trade offensive splatters for steady healing. The support aura remains.

attack.name: Welcoming Brew
attack.description: A 7s cauldron heals allies within 150 reach for 3 health every 0.7s. Keeps its +5% damage and capped life-on-hit aura; fires no splatters.
